name: MLQA: MultiLingual Question Answering
description: MLQA (MultiLingual Question Answering) is a multi-way parallel benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual question answering performance. It contains extractive QA instances gathered from Wikipedia articles across 7 languages: English, Arabic, German, Spanish, Hindi, Vietnamese, and Simplified Chinese. The dataset contains 12,738 QA instances in English and over 5,000 QA instances in each other language, with high parallel alignment allowing cross-lingual evaluation where questions and context paragraphs are in different languages.
